hoi4modutilities.featureFlags.title: Feature Flags
hoi4modutilities.featureFlags.desc: Feature flags are used to disable or enable features. GFX and localisation indexes are enabled without flags; use !gfxIndex or !localisationIndex to disable them. Use technologyShowId to show raw technology IDs in the technology tree preview. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.installPath.title: Install Path
hoi4modutilities.installPath.desc: Hearts of Iron IV install path used by previews and dependency loading.
hoi4modutilities.loadDlcContents.title: Load DLC Contents
hoi4modutilities.loadDlcContents.desc: Whether to load DLC images when previewing files. Enabling this will use more memory.
hoi4modutilities.modFile.title: Working Mod File
hoi4modutilities.modFile.desc: Path to the working .mod file. This file is used to read replace_path. If not specified, will use first .mod file in first folder of the workspace.

hoi4modutilities.formatWorkspace.title: Format Workspace HOI4 Files
hoi4modutilities.formatter.ignoreFiles.d: Workspace-folder-relative glob patterns for files excluded from document, range, on-type, and workspace formatting. Use forward slashes, for example common/generated/** or **/legacy.txt. The default list skips vanilla-derived folders such as interface, gfx, common/technologies, common/units (except names_divisions and names_ships), and history/states. Setting this value replaces the default list.
hoi4modutilities.previewWheel.title: Preview wheel behavior
hoi4modutilities.previewWheel.desc: Auto: mouse wheel zooms and trackpad scrolls. Zoom: always zoom. Scroll: pan; Ctrl/Cmd + wheel zooms in every mode.
